niche.habitat: Dust-dense lanes of the Verrin ring, mid-shear zones
niche.diet: Ice grains, peroxide frost, clathrate scraps, micro-organisms
niche.active: Continuous grazer; enters clathrate tun during eclipses and cascade alarms

body: Flattened silicate-ice carapace, lateral claws, tucked brood-chamber, reaction-mass siphons

chains.trait: Flattened silicate-ice carapace shields internal organs
links: Prevents sterilizing radiation and impact vaporization
Driven by constant hypervelocity debris flux

skill.effect: Reduces damage by 80% for 2 laps, costs 5% mass.

chains.weakness: Immobile while locked, heavy mass drains delta-v.
observe: Impact craters filled with regrowth ice

chains.trait: Sideways skittering gait conserves orbital energy
links: Lateral movement avoids costly radial orbital changes
Low profile minimizes cross-section to vertical impacts
Claws optimized for rowing through dust shear

skill.effect: Moves 15 m/s sideways relative to ring, silent and stable.

chains.weakness: Cannot move radially quickly, easy target for phasing.

chains.trait: Crushing claws fracture ice for sublimation propulsion
links: Sublimation provides reaction mass for orbit keeping
Cracks ice and harvests peroxide fuel
Requires high force to break ring grains

skill.effect: Breaks ice grain, gains +10 delta-v and heals 5% mass.

chains.weakness: Cracking requires proximity, risks exposure to plasma.
observe: Peroxide frost glows magenta on mouthparts

chains.trait: Tucked abdomen seals brood during radiation spikes
links: Clathrate cap protects spores from kilogray doses
Tucked mass stabilizes rotational inertia for maneuvers
Brood uses parent's reaction mass for launch

skill.effect: Protects 3 offspring for 20 laps, reduces mobility.

chains.weakness: Sealed brood emits no heat, invisible to radar, but slow to escape.

secrets: During a Kessler cascade, crabs release clathrate spores that drift outward, escaping the debris zone.
The carapace silicate can be harvested to craft shield upgrades.
Crang-lira herds can coordinate magnetic braking by linking claws.
moments: A swarm of crang-lira suddenly skitters sideways, tucking their abdomens to form a shimmering wall of armor that deflects a Kessler cascade, drifting unharmed while the ring burns around them.

journal.en: Carcinisation is just nature's way of building a tank out of a worm.

relations.note: both converged on the crab body plan from unrelated lineages (Borradaile 1916; Keiler, Wirkner and Richter 2017; Wolfe, Luque and Bracken-Grissom 2021)
